name: studio-harness
description: An agency-grade operating system for creators and studios: any channel, any style. Director + departments (intelligence, strategy, growth, creative, production, QA, learning), gates, blind critic panels, mechanical checks and logged decisions, always on through hooks.

workspace_dir.title: Workspace folder
workspace_dir.description: Where your profile, runs, channel dossiers, memory and taste live. Nothing personal is stored inside the plugin.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API key (optional)
youtube_api_key.description: Bring your own key for richer channel and competitor data. Leave empty to use public data only.
